finding: The notice is typed as a retraction of the whole 2011 article, not a partial retraction; Crossref also lists an expression of concern and a correction for that article dated January 2016. Reason for the retraction NOT reached.
locator_quote: Retraction: Src subfamily kinases regulate nuclear export and degradation of transcription factor Nrf2 (Crossref title field)
depth_reached: metadata_only (PubMed record, PMC front-matter XML via E-utilities, Crossref REST); notice body not read
limits: PMC page returned a reCAPTCHA check page and the body is a PDF: stopped for that source. Cause of retraction and any statement on which figures failed are unknown. Crossref relation shows retraction of the article DOI as such.

system: same
finding: PubMed types the record as Retraction Notice with RetractionOf pointing to the 2011 article. Retraction does not by itself make the described relation false; it removes the article as support.
locator_quote: PublicationType Retraction Notice; CommentsCorrections RefType RetractionOf (PubMed XML, paraphrase of fields)
limits: Field names, not prose, are the locator.

system: mouse embryo fibroblasts (Keap1-null and wild-type), cell lines, Nrf2 deletion and point mutants, cotransfection
perturbation: GSK-3 inhibitors; GSK-3 beta expression; Neh6 6S/6A mutant; beta-TrCP
finding: GSK-3 phosphorylates a Ser cluster in Neh6 that overlaps an SCF/beta-TrCP degron and promotes Nrf2 degradation independently of Keap1; the stabilisation is seen with GSK-3 inhibitors in Keap1-null cells and with a Keap1-insensitive mutant.
locator_quote: Nrf2 was stabilized by GSK-3 inhibitors in Keap1-null mouse embryo fibroblasts.
limits: Abstract only: inhibitor identities, concentrations, controls, n and the exact levels measured per panel are not read. Fibroblast and heterologous systems; no neural cell. Same group as E04.

system: same
perturbation: Ser-to-Ala mutant lacking the Neh6 cluster
finding: The mutant is insensitive to beta-TrCP, has lower ubiquitination, and does not coimmunoprecipitate with beta-TrCP; GSK-3 beta enhances the association (a direct test of the route, not of Fyn/Src).
locator_quote: GSK-3β enhanced ubiquitination of Nrf2(ΔETGE) but not that of Nrf2(ΔETGE 6S/6A).
limits: Abstract only. A degradation route in fibroblasts says nothing on what happens in WWOX-deficient neural cells.

system: biochemistry (2D gel, site-directed mutagenesis, NMR) plus mouse liver and hippocampus
perturbation: GSK-3 inhibitor injected intraperitoneally; hippocampal GSK-3 beta absence
finding: Two serines in the DSGISL sequence are phosphorylated by GSK-3 beta and dock to the WD40 propeller of beta-TrCP; GSK-3 inhibition raised Nrf2 and HO-1 in liver and hippocampus.
locator_quote: Intraperitoneal injection of the GSK-3 inhibitor SB216763 led to increased Nrf2 and heme oxygenase-1 levels in liver and hippocampus.
limits: Abstract only. Same laboratory line as E03/E04: not an independent confirmation. Inhibitor is not GSK-3-isoform specific; brain-region sampling, n and timing not read.

system: mouse with hippocampal absence of GSK-3 beta (genetic)
finding: Genetic loss of hippocampal GSK-3 beta gave higher Nrf2 and phase 2 gene products, lower carbonylated protein and malondialdehyde. It is the genetic arm, which makes the inhibitor result less likely to be pure off-target.
locator_quote: mice with hippocampal absence of GSK-3β exhibited increased levels of Nrf2 and phase 2 gene products
limits: Abstract only; which cell types, and whether the effect is neuronal or astrocytic, is not stated in the abstract.

system: primary cortical neuron-astrocyte cultures from ARE-reporter mice
finding: ARE-driven reporter activity is selective for astrocytes in mixed cortical cultures; activation protected neurons from hydrogen peroxide and non-excitotoxic glutamate toxicity.
locator_quote: treatment of primary cortical cultures from ARE reporter mice revealed selective promoter activity in astrocytes.
limits: Abstract only. Concentrations, durations, n, number of litters, neuron:astrocyte ratio not read.

system: Nrf2 knockout cultures; adenoviral rescue and dominant-negative Nrf2
perturbation: tBHQ in Nrf2-null cells; re-expression; DN-Nrf2; PI3K inhibitor
finding: Neither ARE activation nor neuroprotection occurred with tBHQ in Nrf2-null cultures; both were rescued by re-expressing Nrf2 and blocked by DN-Nrf2: the only NFE2L2-dependence control with rescue in the set of read sources.
locator_quote: tBHQ treatment of cultures from Nrf2 knock-out animals resulted in neither ARE activation nor neuroprotection.
limits: Abstract only. PI3K inhibitor result is a separate pathway control. Response to tBHQ only; an electrophile of one class, so not evidence for other compounds.

system: sorted GFP-infected glia-enriched cells versus uninfected neurons; microarray
perturbation: adenovirus GFP or DN-Nrf2-GFP then tBHQ
finding: The change in neuronal gene expression after tBHQ depended on Nrf2 activity in astrocytes (adenovirus targets astrocytes), supporting a neuron-glia route to neuroprotection.
locator_quote: Strikingly, the change in neuronal gene expression after tBHQ treatment was dependent on Nrf2 activity in the astrocytes.
limits: Abstract only; the infection selectivity is high but not exclusive; array details, replicate structure and gene lists not read. Transcript level; protection endpoint was oxidative death, not network function.

system: same
finding: Adenoviral infection preferentially targeted astrocytes over neurons, which is why the DN-Nrf2 result is read as an astrocyte-Nrf2 result.
locator_quote: the adenoviral infection showed a high selectivity for astrocytes over neurons
limits: Abstract only.

system: human hepatocellular carcinoma cell lines and xenograft (non-neural)
perturbation: toosendanin, ML385 (NRF2 inhibitor), p53 activator, ferroptosis inhibitor
finding: In this cancer-cell system drug-induced WWOX activation lowered NRF2 nuclear translocation by ubiquitination-dependent degradation: a WWOX-to-NRF2 link in the sense that more active WWOX corresponds to less NRF2 nuclear protein, which would predict more NRF2 with WWOX loss. Different cell type, drug-induced activation not loss, ferroptosis endpoint.
locator_quote: impeded the nuclear translocation of NRF2 by inducing its ubiquitination degradation
limits: Abstract only; the direction in WWOX-null neural cells is untested; compound effect not separated from WWOX in the abstract beyond the stated WWOX dependence. Stage 2 source.

perturbation: CRISPR WWOX knockout versus parental line
finding: NFE2L2 0.75x, NQO1 0.73x, HMOX1 1.67x, SRXN1 1.33x KO over WT; recomputed with no mismatch. Mixed signature.
locator_quote: The 2 WT are the survivors of a post hoc exclusion

finding: Redox transcripts (Nfe2l2, Nqo1 among them per the manifest) are higher in early-passage nulls without higher ROS; ROS is higher only in late passage. A compensated state at early passage is one reading.
locator_quote: ROS is higher in late passage, not in early passage
limits: One sample per genotype for the heatmap; non-neural.

system: Drosophila neurons
finding: Mitochondrial hydrogen peroxide higher.
locator_quote: Drosophila neuronal Wwox knockdown raises mitochondrial hydrogen peroxide
limits: Invertebrate; one reporter; sign differs by context across systems.

system: mouse P47T brain deposit, four regions
finding: Hmox1 and Srxn1 modestly higher in all four regions, Nqo1 mixed, Gclm and Txnrd1 flat; the target score tracks the astrocyte marker score; Hallmark ROS set is a cerebellar finding with myelin genes in its leading edge.
locator_quote: Hmox1 and Srxn1 are modestly higher in all four regions

finding: Il6 up with a significance mark, Tnf-a up without one; n 4 v 4. Cytokine arm, not an NRF2 readout.

finding: Neuronal deletion reproduces the myelin deficit; oligodendrocyte and astrocyte deletions show none. Says where Wwox loss acts, not whether an astrocytic NRF2 response could help neurons lacking Wwox.
locator_quote: oligodendrocyte-specific and astrocyte-specific deletions show no evident anomaly
limits: Three mice per genotype; a flat negative.
